title: 第3694章 未来规划第3693章 铁血将军秒变小奶狗
lines: 午后的阳光斜斜地铺在院子里。
酒杯里的残酒映着天光，晃出细碎的光斑。
午饭吃到一半，酒过三巡，闲聊了很多，秦都尉才将话题引到宗门上面去。
"元初兄弟有没有考虑过，加入某个大宗门。
若有此身份，在镇魔司系统里面，或许会少很多的麻烦。
有宗门，有些事情，也就不用那么多的顾虑。"
"再说吧，暂时没有考虑。"
君无邪笑着说道。
"你得考虑啊。"
秦都尉很无语，这还不明显吗？
自己的师尊兼妻子是清玄宗的执剑峰首座，自己这时候提此事，意思很明显好不好？
他放下酒杯，身子微微前倾，手掌按在桌面上，目光里带着急切。
"你想，不管你要做什么，以你的天赋，在当下时代，肯定会引来不少居心叵测者。
若有宗门背靠，你会省去很多的麻烦。
比如那江远。
你若成为某顶级大宗门的亲传，如江远那样的人，你当时便可直接抽他，他父亲都不敢吭一声。
当然，你若是有那样的身份，江远也不敢明着针对你，只会暗中来阴的。
但至少你可以直接对其出手，不用顾虑什么。"
"秦都尉说的有道理。
只是目前我修为尚浅，若是加入大宗门，同样会有不少麻烦。
只怕那些对我不满者，比江远难缠多了。"
"小事，以你的天赋，只要有资源，何愁不能快速突破境界？
只要你成为大宗亲传，低中星级的基础丹药，还不是任你消耗？"
秦都尉的话语中充满了诱惑，说到兴奋处，朝君无邪挤了挤眼，端着酒杯又碰了过来。
杯沿相撞，发出清脆的叮响，在安静的院子里荡开。
"你这是给我找好去处了是吧？"
君无邪笑着与他二次碰杯，仰头饮尽杯中的残酒。
"不然呢，我舍得让你天赋被埋没，一直在镇魔司慢慢成长吗？
再说了，肥水不流外人田。
你这样的天赋，当然应该去我的师门了。
我清玄宗，在龙腾王朝那也是顶级大宗之一，底蕴深厚。
正好，过些时日，我们清玄宗宗主，破例招收亲传弟子。
虽然会有不少竞争者，但以你的本事，再突破些境界，力压所有竞争者，还不是轻轻松松。"
秦都尉说着，看了身旁的师尊一眼。
秦诗怡正端着茶杯抿了一口，眼神里藏着赞许，微微对他点了点头。
"宗主亲传？"
君无邪并非没有想过加入宗门。
来到这个世界，得按照这个世界的规则与模式来。
content_en:
;;
The afternoon sun slanted across the yard.
The remaining wine in the wine glass reflected the skylight, creating tiny specks of light.
Halfway through lunch, after three drinks and a lot of small talk, Captain Qin brought the topic to the sect.
"Brother Yuanchu, have you ever considered joining a large sect?
If you have this identity, you may have a lot less trouble in the Demon Suppression System.
With a sect, there is no need to worry so much about certain things. "
"Let's talk about it, I haven't considered it yet."
Jun Wuxie said with a smile.
"You have to think about it."
Captain Qin was speechless. Isn't it obvious?
His master and wife are the leader of the Qingxuan Sect's Sword-holding Peak. If he mentions this matter at this time, his meaning is obvious, okay?
He put down the wine glass, leaned forward slightly, put his palms on the table, and looked eagerly.
"You think, no matter what you want to do, with your talent, in this era, you will definitely attract many people with ulterior motives.
If you have a sect to back you up, you will save yourself a lot of trouble.
For example, Jiang Yuan.
If you become a direct descendant of a top sect, like Jiang Yuan, you can whip him directly at that time, and his father will not dare to say a word.
Of course, if you had that status, Jiang Yuan would not dare to target you openly, and would only do it secretly.
But at least you can attack it directly without worrying about anything. "
"What Captain Qin said makes sense.
It's just that my cultivation level is still shallow at the moment. If I join a large sect, I will also have a lot of troubles.
I'm afraid those who are dissatisfied with me will be much more difficult to deal with than Jiang Yuan. "
"It's a small thing. With your talent, as long as you have the resources, why worry about not being able to break through the realm quickly?
As long as you become a direct descendant of the large sect, aren't the basic elixirs of low and medium star levels free to be consumed by you? "
Captain Qin's words were full of temptation. When he got to the point of excitement, he winked at Jun Wuxie and clinked the wine glasses again.
The rims of the cups collided with each other, making a crisp clang and swaying in the quiet courtyard.
"You're looking for a good place for me, right?"
Jun Wuxie smiled and clinked glasses with him a second time, then raised his head and drank the remaining wine in the glass.
"Otherwise, am I willing to let your talent be buried and grow slowly in the Demon Suppression Division?
Besides, the good news does not flow to outsiders.
With a talent like yours, of course you should join my school.
My Qing Xuanzong is also one of the top sects in the Longteng Dynasty and has a profound foundation.
It just so happened that some time later, our Qingxuan Sect leader made an exception to recruit direct disciples.
Although there will be many competitors, with your ability, it will not be easy to break through to some realms and defeat all competitors. "
Captain Qin said and glanced at the master beside him.
Qin Shiyi was taking a sip from the tea cup, with approval hidden in her eyes, and nodded slightly to him.
"Personally passed down by the sect master?"
It was not that Jun Wuxie had never thought about joining the sect.
When you come to this world, you have to follow the rules and patterns of this world.
